Skandagiri Trek

    escape2explore presents Karnataka`s most adventurous, "Skandagiri Sunrise Trek - 2025" ✦ Activity Location: Skandagiri Hill ✦ Start time: 11:00 PM ✦ End time: 01:30 PM ✦ Trek Distance: 5-6 km ✦ Skandagiri Height: 1,450 ft. ✦ Trek Difficulty: Moderate About Skandagiri Sunrise Trek: Do you love adventures and are looking for an exciting and different hiking experience? You need to go no farther than the Skandagiri trek, one of the five peaks in the picturesque Chikballapur area referred to as the "Panchagiris." Nature enthusiasts should not miss this walk, Skandagiri Trek which attracts adventurers of all skill levels with its special fusion of history and natural beauty. A physical trip and a step back is the trek to Skandagiri Hill. It starts with the old Papagni Mutt, a hallowed site from antiquity.
